Page 82 Cont.
Oct. 17 John Francis -17- had diptheria when 9 years old ... had a very close call ... lost speech and memory at tim ..... Now quite O.K. except finds it difficult to read.
Lawrence Bellean - 45 - double hernia - had operation on throat for "supposed to - cancer is cured of that but has tube in throat.
Dr. James Hanson - 31 - in Hosp'l 3 - three months ...
Norma Deratany - 38 - Thanksgiv- Had heart trouble, was coming to monastery that evening and had a stroke .... came notwithstanding and has astonished the doctors.
Anna Stack - 41 - Heart & liver trouble .... hard to sleep.
Anna Malinowski - 39 - diabetis - fears Goiter operation - 2nd time
Page 83 Oct. V. Sister Mary Therese - Dearborne - to be operated on for inward can- cer - has been very active .....
Loraine Gowenlock - 22 - operation successful
Thomey O'Sullivan 2'2 - 24 transfusions - Drs. say "no hope.
Oct. 26
Patrick V. Fearn - 54 - head-aches - dizzy - heart
Margaret Egle - 44 - Eye infection: threatened lost of sight. .. Thanks be to God - restored - working again
Lawrence Irvine - 76 - heart .... and fits - spasims -
23 Robert D. Fisher - 42 - strep - blood-infection - has wife and mother and four young children ..... Drs. say only a miracle ....
Jerome Haleman 10 - ostematitis - has had 20 operations - started from bruise they think.
Page 84 Oct. 29 Raymond DeRush - 6 - had "flue" six months ago - losing sight & power to walk - Enrolled To-day
Mrs. Irene Secord - 40 - intestinal cancer: operated on 26th: fur- ther operations feared. Enrolled Today
